generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of seeing creativity that will serve you in every advanced task from here on. Each problem with no routine solution is a chance to generate a new option, each stalled strategy a chance to amend rather than repeat, and each source a reading you can open up and argue. The habit to keep is simple: treat creativity as something you exercise deliberately, in your own work and judgement.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are given problems without settled methods, the people who get better are the ones who generate and defend new options under uncertainty. The attribute you have just learned to name and exercise is one you will use long after you graduate.
